blessedUnder.note: Match required on glVersion string. A mismatch means mesa was upgraded on this VM -- re-bless with --bless, do not treat a mismatch alone as a regression.

productionConfig.note: Q01: mirror of the orangepi preset (constrained_renderer_config.cpp:307, zone budget 20, count mode). Consumed by BOTH scripts/ci/visual_gate.py (run_benchmark) and scripts/pi/ (pi_common.py) so the harness measures what production actually ships instead of full per-pixel lighting. The orangepi preset's object budget (10) is NOT mirrored here -- meaningful only with --objects, which the harness doesn't pass (out of scope, would change scene content). Do NOT add these flags to any zone's extraArgs -- pi_common.build_pose_args asserts extraArgs contains only --camera-pose entries. Q03: --player-light-level replaces the benchmark's old fixed-attenuation lamp fixture with a production-mirrored lightstone (renderer_entities.cpp), including the x3 color boost the shader receives (renderer_sim_bridge.cpp:745) and the per-vertex slot-0 fill that lights demoted regions. Level 9 = Greater Lightstone (TypeToLevel, light_source.h) -- the best practical in-game light per Will; level 10 is Globe of Stars.

memoryCoverage.note: T80: SEPARATE from the zones[] block above -- a distinct benchmark invocation (--eqe1-path/--objects/--entities/--test-races) that exercises eqe1MappedBytes/eqe1ArchiveCount/placeableObjectsBytes/characterModelsBytes, which the zones[] golden-image runs above always baseline at zero (they never load objects, entities, or an EQE1 archive). Ships unblessed -- no zone below carries a "memory" baseline yet, so verify_memory_coverage() reports NOT YET BLESSED and skips assertion rather than false-failing. Proposed baseline values are in refactor/T80_memory_gate_coverage.md's Review, pending Will's sign-off in chat before a real --bless. See scripts/ci/visual_gate.py's MEMORY_COVERAGE_* constants for the fixed entity count/race list/frame count this run uses. T303 (2026-08-28), what these numbers DO NOT cover: placeableObjectsBytes here is STATIC ARCHIVE PLACEABLES ONLY -- the benchmark never connects to a server, so the objects EQEmu sends at zone-in (the object table: ground spawns, forges, containers; and the doors table) are not counted, while the production field of the same name (renderer_diagnostics.cpp, over objectNodes_) counts BOTH populations. characterModelsBytes covers only the pinned race list (MEMORY_COVERAGE_TEST_RACES = 1..5). These are regression detectors on a FIXED sample of three zones and five races, not coverage of either category -- bless them as such.
